_comment: For AI agents: supply tasks, questions, or both. Bank materials are shared across courses. Omit subject. The UI assigns ids automatically. JSON import also generates a UUID for each task or theory question if its id is omitted. Give a task an explicit id when a work will attach it via taskId or a theory question will reference it in taskIds. For example, json-sum below can be used in either link. Use title and Markdown prompt. mode=stdout uses main.cpp and cases with input/output strings; mode=unit accepts main.cpp, task_name.cpp, task_name.h and cases with C++ code. reference is the literal reference solution, minutes is a positive solving-time limit or an empty string, logs is boolean. Each check is off, warn or block. Theory questions use taskIds from the shared bank, including tasks created in this file; [] leaves the question unlinked. Import creates records atomically and rejects duplicate ids. Defaults: logs=false, format=block, static=warn, dynamic=warn. Use mode=none for a program without tests; omit cases or use an empty array.

tasks.title: Сумма двух чисел
tasks.prompt: Считайте два целых числа и выведите их **сумму**.
tasks.reference:
#include <iostream>
int main() { int a,b; std::cin >> a >> b; std::cout << a+b; }
